turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Arre yaar, yeh toh sach mein mixed feelings wala scene hai. Pandrah saal se plan kar rahi ho, co-director ho, opening dance ke liye woh specifically tujhe hi chahti hai — woh excitement toh samajh aa rahi hai. Saath mein Ramzan ke beech mein poora sangeet + cocktail, roza ke saath dance karna... energy, timing, sab soch ke dar lagna bhi bilkul normal hai.

Tu dono cheezon ko feel kar rahi hai na — “karna hai” aur “kaise hoga?” Dono valid hain. Shreya ko quietly bata de ki tu dance karna chahti hai, lekin roza ki wajah se thoda adjust karna padega — maybe dance thoda shorter ho, ya uske baad jaldi rest le sake. Woh teri best friend hai, samajh jaayegi.

Tu tension mat le, yeh moment phir bhi special rahega. Tu uske saath khadi hogi, woh tujhe dekh ke khush hogi. Bas apna pace rakh, paani-dates ka plan pehle se soch le. Tu manage kar legi, I know.

Kaisi feel ho rahi hai abhi exactly? Thoda aur bata.

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Haan, yeh wahi rassi wali feeling hai — dono taraf se pyaar, dono taraf se kheench, aur beech mein tu akeli khadi hai.

Shreya mean nahi thi, woh sirf yeh nahi samajh paayi ki roza sirf “ek din ka khana skip karna” nahi hota. Uske liye woh din uski shaadi ka special moment hai, tere liye woh din ibadat ka. Dono ke liye woh din alag maayne rakhta hai. Woh tujhe khilaane ki baat isliye kar rahi hai kyunki usko lagta hai pyaar se sab solve ho jaayega. Lekin tu jaanti hai na, kuch cheezein pyaar se bhi nahi chhodi jaati.

Ammi ka kehna bhi unke hisaab se theek hai. Unke liye Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet galat lagna natural hai. Woh tujhe protect karna chahti hain, apne tareeke se.

Tu kisi ko disappoint nahi kar rahi. Tu bas do alag duniyaon ke beech khadi hai. Yeh tension isliye hai kyunki tu dono se pyaar karti hai.

Abhi sirf itna soch: tu kya karna chahti hai, apne andar se? Dance karna hai, lekin roza todna nahi. Yeh dono saath ho sakte hain. Opening dance short rakh, jaldi nikal ja, paani-dates ka apna chhota sa setup leke ja. Shreya ko calmly bata de, “Main aungi, dance karungi, lekin roza nahi todungi. Mujhe support karna.” Woh samajh jaayegi, kyunki woh tujhe chahti hai, tera roza nahi.

Ammi ko bhi dheere se keh de ki tu jaa rahi hai lekin apni hadd mein. Unko bhi time lagega, lekin woh teri ammi hain, aakhir mein maan jaayengi.

Tu rassi nahi hai. Tu woh ladki hai jo dono ko sambhaal rahi hai. Yeh bhi ek tarah ki strength hai.

Abhi mann kaisa hai? Thoda halka hua ya abhi bhi tight feel ho raha hai?

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Nahi, main yeh nahi bolungi ki yeh “itna bura nahi hai.”

Tu thaki hui hai — woh clearly dikh raha hai. Escape sochna thakaan ka symptom hai, character ka nahi. Lekin yeh jhooth chhota nahi hai. Pandrah saal ki dosti, co-director, opening dance — aur phir “office deployment + video call + bada gift.” Shreya ko kabhi pata nahi chalega, yeh guarantee nahi hai. Shaadi ke baad jab photos, reels, “yaad hai na sangeet?” aaye, woh jhooth andar baitha rahega. Aur tu khud ko har baar yaad dilaayegi ki tu us din nahi thi.

Aunties ke sawaal se bachna samajh aa raha hai. Woh exhausting hote hain. Lekin unke liye best friend ko ghost karna expensive padta hai.

Ek beech ka rasta hai, jhooth se sasta:

Shreya ko seedha bol — “Main aungi. Dance karungi. Roza nahi todungi. Mujhe paani-dates ke time nikalna padega, cocktail mein sharaab-food ke sawaalon se bachana. Bas itna support de de.”  
Ammi ko — “Main jaa rahi hoon, apni hadd mein. Ibadat nahi chhod rahi.”

Agar tu sach mein physically/mentally nahi sambhal sakti, toh late aana, sirf dance karke nikal jaana, ya sangeet ka chhota hissa attend karna — yeh jhooth se zyada izzat wala hai.

Tu rassi nahi hai. Tu choose kar sakti hai. Escape draft delete kar, pehle ek seedhi baat Shreya se try kar. Agar woh phir bhi na samjhe, tab sochna.

Abhi mann kitna tight hai — 1 se 10?

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Woh pathar wahi hai — pehli baar deen aur uska bada din ek hi jagah takra rahe hain. Atharah saal ki dosti mein yeh pehla asli clash hai, isliye seene mein itna bhaari lag raha hai. Photos hamesha rahengi, Ramzan bhi. Tu kisi album ki sad story nahi banna chahti, yeh bilkul samajh aa raha hai.

Lekin sad story tab banti hai jab tu ya toh jhooth bolke gayab ho jaaye, ya phir apna roza todke andar se khud ko dhokha de. Dono hi daag chhodte hain — ek dosti pe, ek tere andar.

Beech ka rasta album ko khush rakh sakta hai: tu wahan ho, opening dance ho, lekin apni hadd ke saath. Short, present, roza ke saath. Shreya ko abhi, pyaar se, seedha bol de — “Main aungi, nachungi tere saath, lekin roza nahi tootega. Mujhe thoda space aur cover chahiye aunties se. Bas itna.” Woh tujhe chahti hai, tera roza nahi. Agar woh samajh gayi, photos mein tu uske saath khadi dikhegi, muskurati, apni. Agar nahi samjhi, toh woh alag baat hai, lekin pehle try toh kar.

Ammi ko bhi utna hi seedha: “Main jaa rahi hoon apni ibadat ke saath.” Unko time lagega, lekin tu unki beti hai.

Tu rassi nahi, tu woh ladki hai jo dono cheezon ko izzat de rahi hai. Yeh handle galat nahi hoga agar tu jhooth ke bajaye apni baat rakhogi. Album mein tu uski best friend dikhegi jo aayi, nachi, aur apni rahi.

Pathar abhi bhi hai kya, ya thoda hila? Kya kehna chahti hai Shreya ko exactly, soch ke bata. Main sun rahi hoon.
